UPDATE session_queued_messages SET
                   state = 'queued',
                   failure_reason = $1,
                   claude_session_id = NULL,
                   pasted_at = NULL,
                   acked_at = NULL,
                   updated_at = datetime('now', 'subsec')
               WHERE id = $2 AND state IN ('pasting', 'pasted')
